name: GEF Small Grants Programme India
summary: India's SGP country programme, hosted by TERI, gives community grants to registered Indian NGOs in five priority landscapes for conservation of threatened ecosystems and species, sustainable agriculture and related themes.

status.quote: Submission Deadline 15 September 2026 up to 1800 hours

deadline.quote: Submission Deadline 15 September 2026 up to 1800 hours

administered_by.quote: Under the 8th Operational Phase of the GEF Small Grants Programme in India, The Energy and Resources Institute (National Host Institution) is inviting proposals for Community Grants.

applicant_types.quote: Be a registered NGO/Trust/Society in India.

geography.quote: You are hereby requested to submit a Proposal for Community Grants in the selected focus landscapes of Aravallis/ Western Ghats/ Coastal/North-East and Himalayas under the Eighth Operational Phase of the GEF Small Grants Programme in India.

access.quote: Notice inviting Organizations to submit proposals for Community Grants under the Eighth Operational Phase of GEF Small Grants Programme in India.

window.quote: Submission Deadline 15 September 2026 up to 1800 hours

amount.quote: Maximum Grant Amount: The SGP provides grant assistance of up to US$75,000 per project, equivalent to a maximum of INR 67,00,000 in India.

co_finance_required.quote: Applicants must provide a minimum co-financing contribution equivalent to the SGP grant amount, maintaining at least a 1:1 ratio.
